title: SQL Injection Probe
summary: Untrusted input is reaching a database query.
education: Use parameterized queries and narrowly scoped database permissions.

title: Cross-Site Scripting
summary: Browser-bound content may execute attacker-controlled script.
education: Encode output for its HTML context and apply a restrictive content security policy.

title: Outdated Dependency
summary: A component in the build has a known exploitable flaw.
education: Track an SBOM, assess reachability, and ship tested upgrades promptly.

title: Exposed Build Secret
summary: A credential escaped into a repository or build log.
education: Revoke first, rotate dependent credentials, then remove the secret and investigate use.

title: License Compliance Claim
summary: A shipped component's license obligations were not met.
education: Inventory licenses and review distribution obligations before release.
